document_strings: After a Time you switched to Piano Lessons Mr. Jerome Tolles recommended you to Interlochen where you had fun.
I don't know if it improved your Piano.
Today you own A Log cabin there.
AT age 24 Cosmopolitan magazine featured you as "Bachelor of the Month."
Today you still hold that TITLE,
We objected 100% your going to Europe at that Time.
After graduation we would have seen to it you would Travel as a Gentleman tourist.
Instead you went with Terry Kafka.
We pictured you coming home tired, under-nourished - sickly.
To our surprise you looked great and had a great time -
Your experiences in Europe helped you get the job at Dalton.
